content.json:
# CatCar Operations Dashboard
Operational health and work-order flow telemetry from Application Insights.

content.title: Daily Work Order Volume
content.query:
union
  (requests
  | where (name contains 'OpenWorkOrder' or url endswith '/work-orders') and (resultCode == '201' or success == true) and (operation_Name contains 'POST' or name contains 'POST')
  | project timestamp, WorkOrderKey = tostring(coalesce(operation_Id, id))),
  (traces
  | where message has 'WorkOrder' and (message has 'opened' or message has 'Opened')
  | project timestamp, WorkOrderKey = tostring(coalesce(operation_Id, itemId)))
| where isnotempty(WorkOrderKey)
| summarize FirstSeen = min(timestamp) by WorkOrderKey
| summarize WorkOrdersCreated = count() by Day = bin(FirstSeen, 1d)
| order by Day asc

content.title: Average Execution Time per Status
content.query:
traces
| where message has 'WorkOrder' or message has 'Status' or message has 'ExecutionTime'
| extend RawStatus = tostring(coalesce(customDimensions['Status'], customDimensions['TargetStatus'], extract("(Diagnóstico|Diagnostico|Execução|Execucao|Finalização|Finalizacao|Diagnosis|Execution|Delivered|Completed)", 1, message)))
| extend Status = case(
    RawStatus in ('Diagnóstico', 'Diagnostico', 'Diagnosis'), 'Diagnóstico',
    RawStatus in ('Execução', 'Execucao', 'Execution'), 'Execução',
    RawStatus in ('Finalização', 'Finalizacao', 'Delivered', 'Completed'), 'Finalização',
    ''
  )
| extend DurationHours = todouble(coalesce(customDimensions['DurationHours'], customDimensions['Duration']))
| where isnotempty(Status) and isnotnull(DurationHours)
| summarize AverageDurationHours = round(avg(DurationHours), 2) by Status
| order by AverageDurationHours desc

content.title: Integration Failure Counts
content.query:
traces
| where severityLevel >= 3 and (message has 'InventoryReservation' or message has 'Outbox' or message has 'Integration' or message has 'Wolverine' or message has 'WorkOrder')
| extend Component = tostring(coalesce(customDimensions['Component'], customDimensions['Category'], case(
    message has 'InventoryReservation', 'InventoryReservation',
    message has 'Outbox', 'WolverineOutbox',
    message has 'Integration', 'Integration',
    message has 'Wolverine', 'Wolverine',
    message has 'WorkOrder', 'WorkOrder',
    'Unknown'
  )))
| summarize FailureCount = count() by bin(timestamp, 1h), Component
| order by timestamp asc
